verses.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！在　神的圣所赞美他！在他显能力的穹苍赞美他！
verses.en: Praise the Lord!Praise God in his sanctuary;praise him in the sky, which testifies to his strength![NOTE:1]
notes: Psalm 150. The Psalter concludes with a resounding call for praise from everything that has breath.
verses.commentary:
150:1-6 The only VERB in this Psalm is "praise" (BDB 237, KB 248) used thirteen times.

- twelve Piel IMPERATIVES (in Psalm 146-150, thirty-three times)

- one Piel IMPERFECT used in a JUSSIVE sense (cf. Ps. 150:6a)

Notice the PREPOSITIONS.

- in a place

- in His sanctuary

- in His mighty expanse (see
SPECIAL TOPIC: THE CIRCLE OF THE EARTH

- because

- His mighty deeds

- His excellent greatness

- with musical instruments (what type is not always clear)

- trumpet (BDB 1051, KB 1447)

- harp (BDB 490, KB 664 II, cf. 2 Sam. 6:5)

- lyre (BDB 614, KB 484, cf. 2 Sam. 6:5)

- timbrel (BDB 1074, KB 1771)

- stringed instruments (BDB 577 I, KB 597)

- pipe (BDB 721, KB 795, NIDOTTE, vol. 3, p. 334)

- cymbals (BDB 852, KB 1031, cf. 2 Sam. 6:5)

- with dancing, Ps. 150:4

- with breath, Ps. 150:6

150:1 This verse may be a literary way
of paralleling Ps. 150:6a.

The "sanctuary" (i.e., temple or on earth, cf. Ps. 148:7-12; also note John H. Walton,
The Lost World of Genesis 1: An Ancient Cosmology; the LXX has "among His saints") would denote
earth and the "expanse" (the celestial realm, cf. Ps. 148:1-4).

It is possible that both Ps. 150:1b and 1c refer to YHWH's (El
in Ps. 150:1b) abode (cf. Ps. 11:4).

verses.zh: 要因他大能的作为赞美他，按着他极美的大德赞美他！
verses.en: Praise him for his mighty acts;praise him for his surpassing greatness!
verses.commentary:
150:2 "His mighty deeds" See notes on
Ps. 145:4,5,6,7,9,12.

verses.zh: 要用角声赞美他，鼓瑟弹琴赞美他！
verses.en: Praise him with the blast of the horn;praise him with the lyre and the harp!
verses.commentary:
150:3 "trumpet" These are blown by
priests. See
SPECIAL TOPIC: HORNS USED BY ISRAEL.

▣ "harp and lyre" These were
instruments used by the Levites in temple worship (cf. 1 Chr. 15:16; 2 Chr.
29:25; Neh. 12:27).

150:6a What a beautiful way to speak
of animate creation (human and animal) praising the Creator (cf. Ps. 103:19-22;
145:21; 148:7-12.

verses.zh: 击鼓跳舞赞美他！用丝弦的乐器和箫的声音赞美他！
verses.en: Praise him with the tambourine and with dancing;praise him with stringed instruments and the flute!

verses.zh: 用大响的钹赞美他！用高声的钹赞美他！
verses.en: Praise him with loud cymbals;praise him with clanging cymbals!

verses.zh: 凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华！
verses.en: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord!Praise the Lord!

FOLLOWING THE ORIGINAL AUTHOR'S INTENT AT PARAGRAPH LEVEL

This is a study guide commentary which means that you are
responsible for your own interpretation of the Bible. Each of us must walk in
the light we have. You, the Bible, and the Holy Spirit are priority in
interpretation. You must not relinquish this to a commentator.

Read the chapter in one sitting. Identify the subjects (reading cycle #3).
Compare your subject divisions with the five translations above. Paragraphing is not inspired, but it is the key to following the original author's intent, which is the heart of interpretation. Every paragraph has one
and only one subject.
